- **Student list pagination:** reads every page, pulls 200 sign-in accounts per page, fails on an error page.
- **Booking history:** requires valid student ID, pass ID, and operation key; checks pass ownership and filters redemptions.
- **Unpinned dependencies:** `bookingPassLinks.ts` (58ed2e5e…), `googleCalendar.ts` (f0626161…), `linkPassToAccount.ts` (a6a9bc24…) — all unchanged.
